title: 第3735章 句句大实话第3734章 和解
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
林傲风看着两人的反应，笑问：“你们是不是不敢相信？”
苏凡两人点头。
“我有自知之明。”
“论天赋，我不如端木雪，论才华，我也相差甚远，所以从来不敢有这样的想法。”
“其实当初继承神子之位，我也不太愿意。”
“因为我知道，一旦成为星辰殿的神子，不仅会卷入爷爷和承天老祖他们的纷争之中，还会引起二叔和婶婶不满。”
“毕竟在二叔和婶婶眼里，我是抢了堂弟林傲天的位置。”
“可同时，我又不敢违背爷爷的意愿，所以只能赶鸭子上架，硬着头皮上。”
林傲风满脸苦涩。
苏凡和李有德打量着此人。
这到底是真心话，还是在装模作样？
如果是真心话，那说明林傲风是一个很聪明，很有眼力劲的人，能看透事情的本质，知道什么能做什么不能做。
但如果是装模作样，那他就是一个极度危险的人物！
因为他善于伪装，懂得隐忍，城府极深。
“我知道你们可能不会相信，但这就是我的心里话，我不喜欢勾心斗角，更不喜欢去争去抢，不怕你们笑话，我就是一个贪图享乐，胸无大志的人。”
“所以，爷爷突然让我来当星辰殿的神子，反而让我有点不适应。”
林傲风摇头苦笑。
在林傲风脸上，苏凡两人没找到半点说话的痕迹，难道他真是这样的一个人？
林傲风端起酒杯：“两位，可以交个朋友吗？你们太可怕，我真不想成为你们的敌人。”
很坦率，心里想什么就说什么。

“可以啊！”
“能和神子交朋友，是我们的荣幸。”
“而且家里的老人常说，多个朋友多条路。”
两人笑了笑，双双端起酒杯，与林傲风手里的酒杯轻轻碰了下。
林傲风满面笑容：“那等进入黄泉试炼，还望两位兄弟多多关照。”
……
茶花谷。
漫山遍野的茶树，迎着晚风摇曳，吞吐霞光，茶香弥漫在整个山谷。
“这个该死的臭男人，居然让我给他的孩子当后妈，雪儿，你就说他过不过分？”
阁楼里。
江采薇气呼呼地看着对面的端木雪。
端木雪一袭白裙纤尘不染，高挑的身材近乎完美，肤如凝脂，白里透红。
琼鼻高挺，唇线分明。
content_en:
Lin Aofeng looked at the two people's reactions and asked with a smile: "Don't you guys believe it?"
Su Fan and the other two nodded.
"I am self-aware."
"In terms of talent, I am not as good as Duanmuxue, and in terms of talent, I am far behind, so I never dare to have such an idea."
"Actually, I was not very willing to inherit the position of Son of God at the beginning."
"Because I know that once I become the Son of God of the Star Palace, I will not only be involved in the disputes between my grandfather and Ancestor Chengtian, but I will also cause dissatisfaction with my second uncle and aunt."
"After all, in the eyes of my second uncle and aunt, I took my cousin Lin Aotian's position."
"But at the same time, I didn't dare to go against my grandfather's wishes, so I had no choice but to rush the duck and go for it."
Lin Aofeng's face was full of bitterness.
Su Fan and Li Youde looked at this person.
Is this true or is he just pretending?
If he is telling the truth, it means that Lin Aofeng is a very smart and discerning person who can see through the essence of things and knows what can and cannot be done.
But if he is just pretending, then he is an extremely dangerous person!
Because he is good at disguise, knows how to be forbearing, and has a very deep city.
"I know you may not believe it, but this is what I mean. I don't like intrigues, and I don't like fighting for things. I'm not afraid of your jokes. I'm just a person who is greedy for pleasure and has no ambition."
"So, grandpa suddenly asked me to be the divine son of the Star Palace, which made me a little uncomfortable."
Lin Aofeng shook his head and smiled bitterly.
Su Fan and Su Fan couldn't find any trace of words on Lin Aofeng's face. Is he really such a person?
Lin Aofeng picked up the wine glass: "You two, can you be friends? You are too scary. I really don't want to be your enemy."
He is very frank and says whatever is on his mind.
"Okay!"
"It is our honor to be friends with the Son of God."
"And the elderly at home often say that many friends lead to many paths."
The two of them smiled, picked up their wine glasses, and lightly touched the wine glass in Lin Aofeng's hand.
Lin Aofeng's face was full of smiles: "When I enter the underworld trial, I hope you two brothers will take care of you."
…
Camellia Valley.
Tea trees all over the mountains and plains are swaying in the evening breeze, puffing out the glow, and the fragrance of tea permeates the entire valley.
"This damn stinky man actually asked me to be the stepmother of his child. Xue'er, are you saying that he can't live a good life?"
In the attic.
Jiang Caiwei looked at Duanmuxue opposite her angrily.
Duanmuxue was spotlessly dressed in a white dress, her tall figure was almost perfect, her skin was like cream, and her skin was white and rosy.
The nose is high and straight, and the lip line is clear.
